IELTS stands for “International English Language Testing System”. It’s a system for testing the language ability for people who need to study or work in an environment where English is the language of communication. It was established in 1989 and is one of the two major English-language tests in the world (TOEFL being the other). IELTS is accepted by most British, Canadian, Australian, Irish, New Zealand and South African academic institutions.
